 Strong hands\-on production experience with at least one major cloud platform:
 



 AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
 



 Candidates should have experience with compute, networking, storage, IAM, security, load balancing, databases, monitoring, backup, high availability, and cloud infrastructure management.
 



  





 2\. CI/CD and DevOps Tools
 



 Strong hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines.
 



 Experience with tools such as:
 



 Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, CircleCI, Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent.
 



 Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, automated builds, testing, deployment, release management, rollback, and production deployments is required.
 



  





 3\. Infrastructure as Code – Terraform
 



 Strong hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, with Terraform highly preferred.
 



 Candidates should have experience creating reusable infrastructure modules, managing state, provisioning cloud infrastructure, maintaining multiple environments, and implementing version\-controlled infrastructure.
 



 Additional experience with CloudFormation, Azure Bicep, ARM Templates, Pulumi or Ansible is advantageous.
 



  





 4\. Docker, Kubernetes and Container Orchestration

 Candidates should have hands\-on experience with Kubernetes deployments, services, ingress, networking, RBAC, secrets, autoscaling, persistent storage, Helm, cluster administration, troubleshooting, and production workload management.
 



 Experience with EKS, AKS and/or GKE is preferred.
 



  





 5\. Automation, Scripting and Production Operations
 



 Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, Shell Scripting and/or PowerShell.
 



 Candidates should have experience automating infrastructure provisioning, deployments, configuration management, operational workflows, monitoring, incident remediation and repetitive production tasks.
 



 Strong Linux administration and production troubleshooting capabilities are required.

* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines supporting development, testing, staging and production environments.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and related technologies.

* Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, postmortems and production reliability improvements.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Architecture, Security, QA and Product teams to improve deployment velocity, infrastructure reliability and engineering productivity.

title: Senior Database DevOps Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
 We are building a talent community for experienced database and DevOps engineers who can design, automate and support business\-critical database platforms. The role provides production and development support for database applications, establishes build and operational standards, and acts as a technical escalation point for complex database issues.
   

  

 You will help design, deploy, migrate and operate Oracle and SQL database environments on Microsoft Azure. Working closely with database design, application and cloud teams, you will create robust, scalable and secure services while supporting the migration of database workloads from on\-premises environments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (When You Join Us)**
 As a Lead Database Engineer \- DevOps, you will combine deep database engineering expertise with automation, cloud and site reliability practices.
   

  

**Architect, Build and Standardise:**
 Develop and maintain database build standards covering security, patching, resilience and high availability. Provide database design support to development projects and help define scalable database architectures. Design backup and recovery, clustering, data management and disaster recovery strategies. Support database connectivity through ODBC, JDBC and vendor\-specific architectures. Review database application code, collaborate on improvements and maintain source code using standard company tooling.
   

  

**Automate and Deliver:**
 Develop automation for database deployment and maintenance using DevOps tooling and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for database changes and platform configuration. Implement Oracle database infrastructure in Azure and migrate workloads from on\-premises environments. Use version control, secrets management, containers and orchestration tools to improve repeatability and control. Ensure solutions align with defined database, security and compliance standards.
   

  

**Operate and Optimise:**
 Monitor database resources and manage capacity to maintain optimum performance and availability. Investigate and resolve production incidents, database issues and service disruptions in a timely manner. Perform performance tuning and diagnostics using query plan analysis and Oracle tools such as AWR, ASH and ADDM. Document and execute backup, restore, upgrade, patching and disaster recovery procedures. Define a database management strategy combining documented checks, automated monitoring and actionable alerts. Maintain database infrastructure, code and integrations as a reliable service for application teams.
   

  

**Protect and Support:**
 Partner with IT Security to maintain database security policy and assess alignment with required controls. Assist Unix administrators and application teams where database expertise is required. Provide technical guidance, troubleshooting support and escalation leadership across technology boundaries. Participate in shift cover and on\-call support, including planned maintenance outside normal business hours and at weekends.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* Build With Purpose \- Start with why. Define the problem clearly. Deliver measurable outcomes.
* Customer Driven \- Work backwards from customer needs. Build for real‑world use, with continuous feedback loops.
* Technically Courageous \- Tackle complex problems, push boundaries, learn from the best, and avoid mediocrity.
* Learn and Be Curious \- Develop a growth mindset. Continuously learn, experiment, and share knowledge.
* Act as Owner \- Operate as stewards of company resources. Prioritise long‑term value.
* Lead with data \- Use precise data to guide decisions, identify risks, and learn from outcomes.
* Dive deep \- Stay close to the details, investigate discrepancies, and act swiftly to correct course.
* Build responsibly, deliver incrementally \- Prioritize scalable, secure, reliable solutions and iterate using customer feedback.
* Collaborate to achieve \- Communicate openly, work respectfully, and value how work is done as much as what is delivered.


**How We Hire**
 Our process is skills‑focused and structured to be fair and consistent. For mainstream coding roles, candidates typically complete a technical assessment (e.g., Codility) before interviews that explore applied technical skills, design thinking, and our Engineering Principles.
   

  

**Why Connect Now?**
**Skip the Line**
 Become part of our database engineering talent community and be considered when a suitable opportunity opens.
   

  

**Exclusive Insights**
 We will discuss opportunities aligned to your experience in database engineering, automation, cloud migration and platform reliability.
   

  

**Career Alignment**
 Share the database platforms, cloud technologies and engineering challenges that best match your career goals
   

  

**How To Join**
 Upload your CV along with a short note about:
   

  

 The database platforms and versions you have supported. Your experience with Azure, cloud migration and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. The automation, scripting and CI/CD tools you use most often.
   

  

 Your experience supporting high\-availability, business\-critical environments and on\-call services. We will review your profile and connect for an informal conversation to understand your interests better.
   

  

**Career Stage:**
 Senior Associate
   

  

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
   

  

 Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
 **Integrity, Partnership** 
 ,
 **Excellence** 
 and
 **Change** 
 underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
   

  

 Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
   

  

 LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
   

  

 Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.
